## Figure 1 - Collection breakdown
```{r}
# ST colours (maximally contrasting, after lumping)
st_levels <- genometa %>%
  mutate(ST_other = fct_explicit_na(fct_lump_n(ST_new, n = 20), na_level = "Unassigned")) %>%
  pull(ST_other) %>%
  levels()

set.seed(4) # For reproducibility of random colors

st_cols <- iwanthue(length(st_levels), plot = FALSE, random = TRUE)
names(st_cols) <- st_levels


# =========================
# 2) First figure:
#    Stacked bar - phylogroups on x, filled by ST
# =========================
p1 <- genometa %>%
  mutate(
    ST_other = fct_explicit_na(fct_lump_n(ST_new, n = 20), na_level = "Unassigned"),
    Consensus_phylogroup_other = fct_lump_n(Consensus_phylogroup, n = 8)
  ) %>%
  count(Consensus_phylogroup_other, ST_other) %>%
  group_by(Consensus_phylogroup_other) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = Consensus_phylogroup_other,
    y = prop,
    fill = ST_other
  )) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = st_cols) +
  labs(
    x = "Phylogroup",
    y = "Proportion of isolates",
    fill = "Sequence type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.4, "cm")
  )



# =========================
# 3) Second figure:
#    Stacked bar - source niche on x, filled by state (NA -> Unknown)
# =========================
p2 <- genometa %>%
  mutate(
    State = fct_explicit_na(as.factor(State), na_level = "Unknown"),
    State = fct_relevel(State, names(state_cols))
  ) %>%
  count(Revised_Source_Niche, State) %>%
  group_by(Revised_Source_Niche) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = Revised_Source_Niche,
    y = prop,
    fill = State
  )) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = state_cols, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = "Source niche",
    y = "Proportion of isolates",
    fill = "State"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.4, "cm")
  )

# =========================
# 4) Combine into 2-row, 1-column figure
# =========================
ggsave(
  filename = figure_path("Figure_1_collection_overview.pdf"),
  plot = (p1 / p2) +
    plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1)) +
    plot_annotation(
      tag_levels = "A",
      tag_suffix = ")"
    ) &
    theme(
      plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14)
    ),
  width = 8.27,
  height = 10,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300,
  useDingbats = FALSE
)

```
